pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions or opening concurrent positions within 300 seconds of an existing open trade on the same symbol.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require multi-timeframe ATR-volatility squeeze filter and minimum 500ms separation between trades; reject entries if spread exceeds 0.30 gold points or dynamic risk exceeds $5.00 per 0.01 lot.
profit_harvest_threshold: Lock in break-even (+0.50 pips) at +$3.00 floating profit; trigger SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST dynamic trailing trailing stop once floating profit reaches +$7.50 to target $15.00-$30.00+ runs.
